mechanism: Both drugs can cause QT prolongation and have potential additive effects on cardiac conduction; primaquine also has hemolytic potential in G6PD-deficient patients which may be compounded by quetiapine's metabolic demands.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; assess G6PD status before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if QT prolongation present or use with caution with cardiac monitoring.
